decision.rationale: Official UBC Department of Radiology provides public undergraduate, postgraduate, residency and fellowship education, research information, clinical faculty resources and Grand Rounds information. The homepage establishes useful departmental content rather than a personal or authentication-only page.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly links research opportunities, awards and an Indigenous youth summer research program.
The homepage links a dedicated research section and its named imaging and clinical research areas.
The homepage links clinical faculty resources and frequently asked questions.
The homepage identifies news and upcoming events and links conferences, Grand Rounds and event announcements.

fallback.rationale: The department provides radiology education programs and academic departmental information; explicit research, opportunity, resource and announcement sections take precedence.
